dedupe_keys.name: adapt2clima decision support tool for agricultural adaptation cyprus crete sicily

description: A web tool that shows climate change impacts on farming in three Mediterranean islands. The ADAPT2CLIMA site and its Climate-ADAPT entry say the tool presents impacts on crop performance, water availability and agriculture in interactive maps and graphs and lets users explore adaptation options and their efficiency, for farmers, policy makers and agronomists. It covers average conditions for 2031-2060 under RCP4.5 and RCP8.5 and extreme dry, wet, hot and cold scenarios under RCP8.5, using crop and hydrological models; it is applied in Cyprus, Crete and Sicily and has an "apply the tool to your area" feature for Italy, Greece and Cyprus. It is free to use online, with a user manual. Coverage is Cyprus, Crete and Sicily. Caveats: the tool dates from the 2014-2020 LIFE programme and the licence is not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives island-scale crop and water impacts under drought and heat scenarios. A related catalogue record is the AgroMetInfo indicators record.
